records.text: A saltwater snapjaw is a turtle found in the Hinterlands. Its appetite for bait and habit of breaking fishing lines make it a nuisance to Revantusk Village's fisherman Katoom the Angler.
A Vilebranch troll combatant stationed in the Hinterlands, this axe thrower attacks by throwing weapons once engaged.
A Vilebranch troll combatant in the Hinterlands, this witch doctor uses Shadow Bolt in combat.
A Vilebranch troll combatant in the Hinterlands, this headhunter attacks by throwing weapons once engaged.
A Vilebranch troll combatant in the Hinterlands, this shadowcaster uses Shadow Bolt in combat.

A Vilebranch troll combatant in the Hinterlands, this berserker can become enraged when badly hurt. Revantusk Village's Guard Captain application names berserkers among its targets, but does not establish this one's personal history or views.
Vilebranch Hideskinners fight with backstabs when behind a target, and badly wounded ones may flee for assistance.

Vilebranch Shadow Hunters are ranged combatants: they shoot and use Shadow Shell and Shadow Word: Pain, and may flee for assistance when badly wounded. Primal Torntusk's guard-captain application task names three of them among its targets, tying these fighters to the threats Revantusk applicants are asked to confront.

Vilebranch Blood Drinkers use Blood Leech at close range and may flee for assistance when badly wounded. Primal Torntusk's guard-captain application task names three of them among its targets, placing these fighters among the threats applicants are asked to confront.

Vilebranch Soul Eaters use Soul Bite at close range. Primal Torntusk's guard-captain application task names two of them among its targets, making them one of the threats applicants are asked to confront.

Vilebranch Aman'zasi Guards are Vile Priestess Hexx's elite minions. Primal Torntusk's wanted order says Hexx and these guards can be found atop Jintha'alor, and calls for five guards to be slain. They can use Shield Slam in combat.
A Witherbark combatant, the Scalper throws attacks in a fight and uses Execute against badly weakened foes.
The Witherbark Zealot is a frontline fighter that can become enraged as it is badly wounded.
The Hideskinner attacks with Backstab and may flee for help when badly hurt, marking it as a close-quarters ambusher that tries to bring others into a fight.
The Witherbark Venomblood may flee for help when badly wounded, drawing other Witherbark fighters into the encounter.
The Sadist takes Battle Stance outside combat and uses Heroic Strike at close range, fighting as a deliberate melee combatant.
The Witherbark Caller uses Shadow Bolt in combat, summons a Witherbark Felhunter when engaged, and may flee for help when badly wounded.

Green Sludges are hostile ooze creatures found around Skulk Rock in the Hinterlands. Fraggar Thundermantle's cleanup request identifies them as part of the area's infestation and calls for ten to be killed; they use corrosive ooze in combat.

Jade Oozes are hostile ooze creatures found around Skulk Rock in the Hinterlands, alongside Green Sludges. Fraggar Thundermantle's cleanup request includes ten Jade Oozes among the creatures to clear from the area; they use diseased slime in combat.
Trained Razorbeaks are combat-trained birds found in the Hinterlands. The small local population uses Rend Flesh in combat.
A Razorbeak Gryphon is found in the Hinterlands. This gryphon uses Rend Flesh in combat.
Razorbeak Skylords are gryphons found in the Hinterlands. They use Rend Flesh and Wing Flap in combat.
Vilebranch Wolf Pups are young wolves found in the Hinterlands. The animals use a single health-triggered combat ability.
Ruppo Zipcoil is an engineering supplies vendor in the Hinterlands. Visitors can browse his goods.
A Highvale Outrunner is one of the high elves at Quel'Danil Lodge. This outrunner calls on her sisters to stop a troll from escaping, showing a hostile stance toward the troll in that encounter.
A Highvale Scout serves among the high elves at Quel'Danil Lodge. When badly wounded, a scout flees for assistance.
A Highvale Marksman serves among the high elves at Quel'Danil Lodge and uses a bow to attack from range, including with Multi-Shot.
A Highvale Ranger serves among the high elves at Quel'Danil Lodge and uses Faerie Fire against nearby opponents.

Mangy Silvermanes are wild wolves of the Hinterlands. Ambassador Rualeth describes wolves as natural predators that have begun targeting gryphons in packs as their usual prey grows scarce; this wolf is one of the animals named in that account.

Silvermane Wolves are predators of the Hinterlands. Ambassador Rualeth says wolves have begun targeting gryphons in packs when ordinary prey is scarce, making them a threat to the gryphons cared for by the Wildhammer dwarves. This wolf is among those named in his account.

Silvermane Howlers are wolves of the Hinterlands. Huntsman Markhor's account describes Silvermane wolves as a danger to troll hunters: they conceal themselves among the brush and terrain, then strike when an opportunity comes. Howlers are among the wolves targeted in his warning.

Silvermane Stalkers are wolves of the Hinterlands. Huntsman Markhor describes Silvermane wolves as a serious threat to troll hunters, waiting concealed among bushes and the landscape before striking when an opportunity arises. Stalkers are among the predators he names.
Vicious Owlbeasts are found in the Hinterlands. They are a distinct owlbeast kind from the Primitive Owlbeasts also found in the region. They use a fatal bite at close range.
Primitive Owlbeasts are found in the Hinterlands. They are a distinct owlbeast kind from the Vicious Owlbeasts also found in the region. They use a shredding attack at close range.
Savage Owlbeasts are dangerous creatures of the Hinterlands, feared for their ferocious claws and beaks. Revantusk hunter Markhor says they have cost many warriors their lives.
Gorkas is a Wind Rider Master whose ride option offers travel by wind rider. He grumbles when interrupted while fishing and hopes to catch a 68-pound grouper.
A Vilebranch troll warrior of the Hinterlands, this fighter has a close-range Strike in its combat repertoire.
A Vilebranch troll known as a Scalper, found near the northern Hinterlands temples according to Mystic Yayo'jin. In combat it can execute badly wounded foes and flee for help when near defeat.
A Vilebranch troll Soothsayer found near the northern Hinterlands temples according to Mystic Yayo'jin, it casts Lightning Bolt in combat.
Jade Sludge uses Sludge Toxin when something comes within 10 yards.
Emerald Ooze uses Corrosive Acid when something comes within 5 yards.
Truk Wildbeard is a bartender who offers goods for sale and quest interaction.

The Atal'ai Exile was cast out after questioning Jammal'an's prophecy to summon Hakkar. He fears the prophecy will destroy the Atal'ai, seeks revenge for his exile, mourns his people, and hopes to return to them. He now lives among the Witherbark, whose companions are wary of strangers.

Rhapsody Shindigger is a former Aerie Peak gryphon pilot whose drinking cost him his place there. Now at a brew camp in the Hinterlands, he needs a strong cocktail before he will recount the flight with Brohann Caskbelly. Rhapsody says he became tipsy, fell into the swamp, and found an Atal’ai tablet among the trolls, confirming the temple’s location.

Falstad Wildhammer, High Thane of Aerie Peak, is dealing with a troll threat when an outsider asks about an old gryphon flight. He speaks brusquely, directs the visitor to Gryphon Master Talonaxe for flight assignments, and warns that lingering will earn real work. His replies show an impatient leader focused on the immediate danger around Aerie Peak.

At Aerie Peak, Talonaxe handles matters while High Thane Falstad is away in Ironforge. He fears for Sharpbeak, Swiftwing's heir, and is moved when the young gryphon is reunited with his parents. He also remembers sending Rhapsody Shindigger to aid the Explorers' League, which his father supported as part of Uldaman's first excavation team.
Rothos is a dragonkin in the Hinterlands.
Thulfram is the innkeeper. He welcomes visitors to a tankard and a chair, and visitors can make the inn their home, browse goods, or try the seasonal Trick or Treat exchange.
Doran Steelwing is a named individual found in the Hinterlands.

Rin'ji is a Witherbark troll who asks for help escaping after losing his axe and being captured. He says he hid a secret on an island at the Overlook Cliffs, and offers that whoever finds it may keep it, while asking that his confidence be kept.

Gilveradin Sunchaser is a camped wine expert who can identify vintages by smell. He has original packaging for Hinterlands Honey Ripple and takes care to keep the drink from being jostled. He calls Malton an old drinking companion and warmly invites him to visit for fine drink and company.

OOX-09/HL is a damaged homing robot that speaks in clipped status reports, clucking as it powers up, detects threats and danger, and activates its combat plan. When its flight systems come online, it announces its intended transport to Booty Bay.
The Wildhammer Sentries serve as guards across several areas of the Hinterlands, forming part of the Wildhammer presence in the region.

Fraggar Thundermantle is a blunt Wildhammer who insists his people are independent rather than part of the Alliance. He respects action over talk and asks newcomers to prove their worth; his work around Skulk Rock is meant to clear sludges and oozes so the Wildhammers can extend their influence. He also directs a troll-necklace bounty as another step toward earning their regard.
Gammerita is a giant snapjaw of the Hinterlands coast, singled out for a photograph. Katoom calls her leader of the saltwater snapjaws and accuses her of stealing his lure.
Vile Priestess Hexx is a prominent target atop Jintha’alor. Primal Torntusk’s wanted order pairs her with five Vilebranch Aman’zasi guards and calls for them to be brought to justice.
Qiaga the Keeper is a named combatant associated with Shadow Word: Pain and Shadow Bolt. She may flee for assistance, and Renew is directed toward a friendly target.

Guthrum Thunderfist is a Gryphon Master whose flight menu offers a choice of destinations. His warning, “Guards!”, and an enraged gryphon summon when engaged give him a guarded presence alongside his travel role.
Sharpbeak is Swiftwing's young gryphon and heir, lost while hunting with his parents in the Hinterlands. A chirp is the only sound attributed to him.
Nioma supplies leatherworking goods and serves as a quest contact.
Harggan supplies blacksmithing goods and offers repairs. He also has a questgiver role.
Razortalon is a rare creature whose combat tactics include Rend and close-range strikes.
Old Cliff Jumper is a rare beast whose attacks include a blood howl and tendon-rending strikes.
The Reak is a rare creature that attacks with black sludge and putrid breath.
Jalinde Summerdrake is a named humanoid.
Retherokk the Berserker is a named humanoid who can become enraged when badly hurt, matching the berserker epithet.
Mith'rethis the Enchanter is a named humanoid who uses Slow, Enchanted Quickness, and Shadow Word: Pain.
Witherheart the Stalker is a named humanoid who uses Sneak and Backstab when positioned behind a target, giving him a stealth and ambush combat role.
Zul'arek Hatefowler is a humanoid who can cast Shadow Bolt Volley.
Soaring Razorbeak is a beast recorded in the Hinterlands, part of the local razorbeak population.
Morta'gya the Keeper is a named Hinterlands figure who fights with Shadow Bolt and Shadow Word: Pain. When injured, Morta'gya renews a friendly target; when badly hurt, Morta'gya flees for help.
Riding Raptor is a beast found in both the Hinterlands and Dustwallow Marsh.

Agnar explains that sprite darters eat meat and vegetation, asks for meat for an egg he is tending, and admits he can only guess at their place in Elune's plans. As the egg nears hatching, he returns it so it can bond with its new parent and offers teasing congratulations on the responsibility.
Killium Bouldertoe is a stable master who helps travelers stable their pets and recover lost companions.
Elder Torntusk's task identifies Hitah'ya the Keeper as the target to kill for the Shackle Key. In combat she uses Shadow Bolt and can cast Renew.

Drakk Stonehand is a leatherworking trainer who gathers materials among the creatures in the hills. He marvels at the fantastic wildlife and invites travelers to return with tales of their encounters.
Howin Kindfeather is a quest giver.
Claira Kindfeather is a quest giver.
Kerr Ironsight is a quest giver.
Verdantine Boughguard is a combatant that casts a spell when engaged in combat.
Verdantine Oracle is a creature with a combat response that casts a spell when wounded.
Verdantine Tree Warder is a creature that responds to being attacked with a spell. Its name suggests a warding role.
Dreamtracker is a creature that fights with spells, including one response used at low health.
Gigget Zipcoil is a trade supplies merchant who offers goods for sale.
A Revantusk Watcher is a sentry identified with the Revantusk. This humanoid represents the watch role.

Lard is the Revantusk innkeeper, a peacekeeper and fish seller who speaks of himself in the third person. He tells of picnicking at a secret spot on an island to the north, being attacked by Vilebranch trolls, and returning hungry and afraid after leaving his lunch behind.
A Revantusk drummer in the Hinterlands.

Primal Torntusk says her mate, Elder Torntusk, was taken in a Vilebranch raid. She says village spies report he is held at Jintha'alor and being prepared for sacrifice, and asks for help rescuing him. She also seeks tainted blood vessels so she can remove their corruption and loosen the blood god's grip on the Vilebranch.

Smith Slagtree is a blacksmith in Revantusk Village, and his stolen tools matter deeply to him: a kind-hearted gnome gave them to him after saving his life when he was a young orc. His delight on their recovery and his warning about the ruthless Vilebranch show his personal attachment to the tools and hostility toward the raiders.

Otho Moji'ko is a Revantusk troll who sells cooking supplies. He urges violence against the Wildhammer and their high elf allies, then asks for a gryphon feather and a bloodied spear to be used as a final warning at Aerie Peak. If that warning is delivered, he regrets that he could not witness the dwarves' reaction.

Mystic Yayo'jin is a Revantusk troll who deals in reagents. She describes the Vilebranch as depraved for feeding on trolls and other humanoids, and urges their destruction. Her remarks invoke Zul'jin as a powerful figure who might have dealt with them, while acknowledging that he has not yet returned.

Katoom is Revantusk Village’s angler and fishing trainer, whose fishing has been disrupted by saltwater snapjaws stealing bait and Gammerita taking his best lure. He asks for help against the turtles and credits his bliss as an angler to his mentor, Nat Pagle, whom he calls the greatest.

Markhor is Revantusk’s master huntsman, responsible for keeping the surrounding wilds safe and beasts in check while the trolls hold their positions and await Zul’jin’s return. He mourns his twin Malkhor, killed in a Vilebranch raid, and seeks his remains so his soul may be saved; he also calls the Wildhammer’s use of gryphons against trolls an injustice.

Elder Torntusk was taken from Revantusk Village by the Vilebranch and held in chains at Jintha'alor, where Hitah'ya the Keeper holds the key to his bindings. He urges a rescuer to recover it so he can go home, then asks that his mate, Primal Torntusk, be told he is coming. His words make clear how urgently he wants to return to her and their village.

Lethon is a formidable hostile presence whose threats center on souls and shadow. He declares that wicked souls will feed his power and says he can sense the shadow on his opponents' hearts, leaving them no rest.

Elder Highpeak speaks of the time when the year is new and the moon shines bright, when the ancients awake. A visitor asks him about Elder Moonstrike, and Highpeak's response to homage to the olden races is to offer a token and wish the visitor well.

Ambassador Rualeth is an Alliance envoy seeking an audience with High Thane Falstad Wildhammer at Aerie Peak. He says earning the chance to present his credentials took effort, and describes the Wildhammers as wary of outsiders. He hopes Featherbeard will support closer ties with the Alliance. Rualeth believes helping defend gryphons from trolls and predators may show the Wildhammers that the Alliance can be a reliable partner. News of Featherbeard's death leaves him horrified; he fears it will provoke retaliation and delay his audience.

Witch Doctor Mai'jin is a Witherbark troll leader and witch doctor in the Hinterlands. He shelters in a cave at Bogen's Ledge, west of Shadra'Alor. His healing ward and magma totem show his use of restorative and elemental magic in battle.

Tcha'kaz is a spider associated with the Witherbark troll leader Witch Doctor Mai'jin. The Alliance envoy Rualeth identifies Tcha'kaz as Mai'jin's pet and names both as targets in his effort to curb attacks on the Wildhammer dwarves and gryphons. When Tcha'kaz dies, Witherbark Bloodlings are summoned.
Renn'az is an ammunition vendor. Visitors can browse his goods.

The Hinterlands Flame Warden tends the Alliance festival flame in the Hinterlands. The Warden invites visitors to honor it and urges them to desecrate Horde festival fires, reflecting the rivalry built into the seasonal celebration.

The Hinterlands Flame Keeper tends the Horde festival flame in the Hinterlands. The Keeper invites visitors to honor it and urges them to desecrate Alliance festival fires, reflecting the rivalry built into the seasonal celebration.

A Crown Agent is a hostile operative encountered in the Hinterlands. Adventurers are sent to kill Crown Agents and destroy a chemical wagon east of Aerie Peak, as the Crown's activity is a problem for both Horde and Alliance.

place_records.text: You are in The Hinterlands, a contested land in the Eastern Kingdoms where both the Alliance and the Horde hold settlements. The Alliance keeps Aerie Peak and Wildhammer Keep, and the Horde keeps Revantusk Village. Trolls are the chief danger, with Witherbark and Vilebranch tribes raiding the hills, while silvermane wolves and owlbeasts roam the wilds.

You are in The Overlook Cliffs, a section of the Hinterlands with a spirit healer. Silvermane stalkers roam the cliffs and a Gammerita is also found here. Saltwater snapjaws break the fishing lines of Katoom the Angler from Revantusk Village, and the captive Witherbark troll Rin'ji says he hid a secret on an island at these cliffs.

You are in Aerie Peak, an Alliance hold in the Hinterlands where High Thane Falstad Wildhammer is dealing with a troll threat. Gryphon Master Talonaxe handles flight assignments while the High Thane is away. Swiftwing's young heir Sharpbeak was lost while hunting, and Talonaxe fears for him. A flight master, stable master and spirit healer also work here.

You are in Wildhammer Keep, an Alliance hold in the Hinterlands. Fraggar Thundermantle insists the Wildhammer are independent of the Alliance and asks newcomers to prove their worth, and he has them clearing sludges and oozes around Skulk Rock. Innkeeper Thulfram keeps the inn, Harggan does repairs, and Drakk Stonehand trains leatherworkers.

You are in Quel'Danil Lodge, where high elves of the Highvale keep a captured Witherbark troll. Rin'ji has lost his axe and begs to be helped out, saying he hid a secret at the Overlook Cliffs. Highvale marksmen, rangers, scouts and outrunners serve here, and silvermane wolves and vicious owlbeasts range nearby.

You are in Skulk Rock, an abandoned Horde position in the Hinterlands, now overrun by jade oozes and green sludges. Silvermane stalkers and savage owlbeasts roam here, and a creature called The Reak has been seen.

You are in Zun'watha, where Witherbark scalpers and zealots are found, with mangy silvermanes and a Zul'arek Hatefowler among the dangers. Bottles of a vile green venom are stored here in great number, which suggests the Witherbark value it greatly.

You are in Shadra'Alor, where Witherbark trolls live and fight. The Atal'ai Exile was cast out of the temple for questioning Jammal'an's prophecy to summon Hakkar, and now lives among the Witherbark. Witherbark broodguards, sadists and callers are dangerous here, and Witherheart the Stalker roams near. A spirit healer also works here.

You are in Jintha'Alor, Vilebranch troll territory in the Hinterlands. Vilebranch blood drinkers, shadow hunters and soul eaters are dangerous here. Elder Torntusk, taken from Revantusk Village, is held in chains, and Hitah'ya the Keeper holds the key to his bindings. Vile Priestess Hexx holds a key to a gryphon's cage at its top.

You are in The Altar of Zul, on the western edge of Vilebranch territory in the Hinterlands. Vilebranch soothsayers, axe throwers, scalpers and wolf pups are found here, and silvermane howlers and primitive owlbeasts range nearby. Sharpbeak, the lost gryphon child, was once sought on the top of the altar.
You are in Seradane, where a spirit healer offers a return to life for a price. Verdantine boughguards, oracles and tree warders are hostile here, and Lethon and Rothos are notable among them.

You are in Featherbeard's Hovel, where Featherbeard's journal records Witherbark raids on the gryphon aeries and a rash of egg thefts. He suspected a Witherbark witch doctor named Mai'jin. Mangy silvermanes and an old cliff jumper are hostile here.

You are in Shindigger's Camp, a brew camp in the Hinterlands. Rhapsody Shindigger, a former Aerie Peak gryphon pilot whose drinking cost him his place there, now stays at the camp, and Gilveradin Sunchaser is a wine expert who can identify vintages by smell.
You are in Valorwind Lake, part of the Hinterlands. Primitive owlbeasts and Silvermane howlers haunt it.
You are in Agol'watha, a temple in the northeast of the Hinterlands. Green sludges and jade oozes trouble the ground here, along with primitive owlbeasts and Silvermane howlers.
You are in Hiri'watha, a Witherbark village in the Hinterlands. Witherbark trolls live here alongside silvermane wolves and vicious owlbeasts.
You are in The Creeping Ruin, a ruin in the Hinterlands. Green sludges and jade oozes share it with primitive owlbeasts and silvermane stalkers.
You are in Bogen's Ledge, a ledge in the Hinterlands. Witherbark sadists, vicious owlbeasts and silvermane wolves roam it. The hostile Tcha'kaz and Witch Doctor Mai'jin are found here.

You are in Revantusk Village, a Horde troll village in the Hinterlands. Its inn, stable and flight master serve travelers. Lard keeps the inn, Gorkas runs the wind riders, and Huntsman Markhor is the stable master. Vilebranch raiders invade the village, and spies say they hold Elder Torntusk captive at Jintha'alor.
